method: scripts/hook-log-build.py: studio.db publishing + latest API snapshot (perVideo90d, 90-day window) + production hook/story/script-doctor/viral json; null = unknown

videos.title: "You can't see outside": Suni Williams at splashdown
videos.hook_mechanism: Extreme-True-Moment Tease (head copy 'it glazes over and then you can't see outside' 2152.44-2155.0)
videos.hook_premise: Inside re-entry the window glazes over and Suni cannot see out, until a tennis shoe passes the window and she knows the recovery team is there.

videos.title: "We were always coming back" - Suni Williams
videos.hook_mechanism: Hard Open on first-person claim + one-word Contrarian overlay
videos.hook_premise: Suni Williams, whose mission was called 'stuck', says in her own words they were always coming back, and the lesson she wants kids to keep is that life takes turns.

videos.title: "It's humbling" - Artemis II's Christina Koch on a team accomplishment
videos.hook_premise: Asked what to tell the first woman on the Moon, Koch says the word to hold onto is humbling, and the world will try to make it about one person.

videos.title: "I know that can sound a little bit corny" - NASA astronaut Chris Williams on seeing Earth
videos.hook_mechanism: Extreme-True-Moment Tease (head copy of 'I know that can sound a little bit corny', src 1341.79-1342.89)
videos.hook_premise: An astronaut admits what he felt over Earth might sound corny, then says it anyway: we are all in this place together.

videos.title: Artemis II astronaut Jeremy Hansen: "small and powerless, but yet powerful together"
videos.hook_mechanism: Extreme-True-Moment Tease (cold open on 'infinitesimally small', real head copy)
videos.hook_premise: An Artemis II astronaut says looking at Earth and Moon made the crew feel infinitesimally small, yet powerful together.

videos.title: Butch Wilmore: "It doesn't mean there's no pain" - 9 months in space
videos.hook_premise: A man who spent 9 months stranded in space says what he held onto: contentment does not mean there is no pain.

videos.title: "In between two worlds" - NASA astronaut Jonny Kim
videos.hook_premise: A NASA astronaut says growing up Korean American left him belonging to neither world, and what that hurt gave him.

videos.title: Artemis II commander Reid Wiseman: "I just grabbed this bracelet"
videos.hook_premise: Four astronauts could take almost nothing to the Moon; the Artemis II commander says the thing that mattered most was a bracelet his daughter made.

videos.title: Neil Armstrong, 1989: "I was pleased doing the things I was doing"
videos.hook_premise: The first man on the Moon is told he 'disappeared off the face of the Earth'; his own answer is that he was simply content.

videos.title: Astronaut Jonny Kim to the crew still in orbit: "I love you all. I miss you."
